visual_read.composition_style: Fully centered messaging over a bright shop interior; merchandise below the copy; the same brand frame as the left-column golds.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Uppercase condensed; the headline's key phrase in red; spaced small caps; script accents.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Logo centered; brand name in the headline; laptop logo.

strongest_attributes: Centered structure — the Owner explicitly wanted compositional variety and approved this
'Sell More' as a two-word red headline: business capability in two words
Icon row horizontal under the headline rather than a column — a different rhythm
transferable_lessons: CENTERED messaging is a valid professional-seller structure; the reference system must carry a RANGE (centered, asymmetric, environmental, merchandise-led)
Professional-seller messaging: capability and ease ('Sell More', 'Reach More Buyers. Move More Inventory.') without showing complicated software
Audience line 'Professional Sellers' as an eyebrow over the headline
do_not_generalize: The chalkboard category list and mug text — scene accents
